comment: HARDWARE PROBE, not a release effect. Answers the two questions a freeze effect depends on: (1) can a running effect SEE the slot's bypass bit change, promptly enough to use the footswitch as a capture trigger, and (2) does input audio still reach the effect while it is bypassed, so a ring buffer can already be recording at the instant you stomp. Silent by default. Two mid beeps at boot = alive; two HIGH beeps = slot switched ON; one LOW beep = slot switched OFF (hearing that at all also re-proves the effect keeps running while bypassed); a short mid tick, at most once a second, while bypassed and playing = input audio is being delivered. Deliberately does NOT return early on params[0], since that return is the behaviour under test. Knobs are hardcoded and ignored: a probe must not depend on the mechanism it is testing.
gid_comment: 0x07 = SFX category, matching the other probes; keeps diagnostics out of the Delay group with the release pack.
fxid_comment: 0x01C0. Free: no stock effect uses it, not a retired custom alias, and one past CtxWatch (447). Probe-only, never shipped in dist/.
